verdict.rationale: Cerebras hosts a live llms.txt index (verified via probe returning HTTP 200 with a structured documentation index) and individual docs pages are also served in markdown form with explicit pointers back to llms.txt, exactly matching the agent-oriented docs pattern. This is directly confirmed by hands-on probes, not just vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that an agent has actually consumed llms.txt successfully in practice.
